comment: Upstream-owned files whose fork text stays in the tracked tree on purpose.
The overlay file store (overlays/enact/files/) is the mechanism for a
whole upstream-owned file whose only consumer is the prepared tree. It
cannot reach the tracked tree, so a file that the tracked tree's own
tooling reads -- GitHub Actions, the scripts/ci suite, the web build,
install.sh, the docs gate, cargo-deny -- has to keep its fork text in
This list is that record. Every path below is an upstream-owned file
that carries fork text in the tracked tree, with the reason it cannot
be overlaid. The release gate compares the tracked tree against the
pinned upstream base and refuses to release when a path drifts that is
not on this list. A new upstream-owned delta therefore fails the gate
until someone adds it here, with its reason.
A path leaves this list when its consumer moves to the prepared tree.
